"range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "

                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Anam and Bikash invest in a business in the ratio 3 ∶ 2. If in a particular month, Anam gets ₹3,840 as profit

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Concept used:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Profit is shared as per their investment ratio

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Calculation: 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              If Anam gets 3x then Bikash gets 2x 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Total will be 3x + 2x = 5x

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              As per the question,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              3x = 3840

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Then 5x = 3840 × 5/3 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ Rs 6400

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct option is 4

                                                                                                                                                              \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                              दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              अनम और बिकाश एक व्यवसाय में 3 ∶ 2 के अनुपात में निवेश करते हैं। यदि किसी विशेष महीने में, अनम को लाभ के रूप में ₹3,840 प्राप्त होते हैं। 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              प्रयुक्त संकल्पना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              लाभ उनके निवेश अनुपात के अनुसार साझा किया जाता है। 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              यदि अनम को 3x प्राप्त होता है, तो बिकाश को 2x प्राप्त होता है। 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              कुल 3x + 2x = 5x होगा। 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              प्रश्नानुसार,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              3x = 3840

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              तब 5x = 3840 × 5/3

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 6400 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ सही विकल्प 4 है। 

                                                                                                                                                              \n", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                              ఇచ్చినది:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ఆనం మరియు బికాష్ 3 ∶ 2 నిష్పత్తిలో వ్యాపారంలో పెట్టుబడి పెడతారు. ఒక నిర్దిష్ట నెలలో, అనమ్‌కు లాభంగా ₹3,840 లభిస్తుంది

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ఉపయోగించిన భావన:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              వారి పెట్టుబడి నిష్పత్తి ప్రకారం లాభం పంచబడుతుంది

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              గణన:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ఆనం 3 రెట్లు సాధిస్తే, బికాష్ 2 రెట్లు పొందుతాడు

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              మొత్తం 3x + 2x = 5x ఉంటుంది

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ప్రశ్న ప్రకారం,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              3x = 3840

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              అప్పుడు 5x = 3840 × 5/3

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ రూ. 6400

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ సరైన ఎంపిక 4

                                                                                                                                                              \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                              दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              अनम आणि विकास 3 ∶ 2 च्या गुणोत्तरात व्यवसायात गुंतवणूक करतात. जर एखाद्या विशिष्ट महिन्यात, अनमला नफा म्हणून ₹3,840 मिळाले.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              वापरलेली संकल्पना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              गुंतवणुकीच्या गुणोत्तरानुसार नफ्याचे वितरण होते.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              अनमला 3x मिळतील तर विकासला 2x मिळतील,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              एकूण 3x + 2x = 5x 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              प्रश्नानुसार,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              3x = 3840

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              आता 5x = 3840 x 5/3

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 6400 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ पर्याय क्रमांक 4 हे योग्य उत्तर आहे.

                                                                                                                                                              \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                              প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              আনাম এবং বিকাশ 3 ∶ 2 অনুপাতে একটি ব্যবসায় বিনিয়োগ করেন। যদি একটি নির্দিষ্ট মাসে, আনাম লাভ হিসাবে 3,840 টাকা পায়

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              অনুসৃত ধারণা:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              তাদের বিনিয়োগের অনুপাত অনুযায়ী লাভ ভাগ করা হয়

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              যদি আনাম 3x পায় তাহলে বিকাশ 2x পায়

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              মোট হবে 3x + 2x = 5x

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              প্রশ্ন অনুযায়ী,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              3x = 3840

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              তাহলে 5x = 3840 x 5/3

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 6400 টাকা

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ সঠিক বিকল্পটি হল 4

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              અનમ અને વિકાસ 3 ∶ 2 ના ગુણોત્તરમાં વ્યવસાયમાં રોકાણ કરે છે. જો કોઈ ચોક્કસ મહિનામાં, અનમને નફો તરીકે ₹3,840 મળે છે

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              અવધારણા:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              નફો તેમના રોકાણના ગુણોત્તર મુજબ વહેંચવામાં આવે છે

                                                                                                                                                              ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              જો અનમને 3x મળે છે તો વિકાસને 2x મળે છે

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              પ્રશ્ન મુજબ,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              3x = 3840

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              પછી 5x = 3840 x 5/3

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ સાચો વિકલ્પ 4 છે

                                                                                                                                                              Given:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                               7 people working 4 hours a day can complete a task in 14 days.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Concept used:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Total work = Total number of days × total people 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              The total work wil be 14 × 7 × 4 units 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              So the required number of days,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              7 व्यक्ति प्रतिदिन 4 घंटे कार्य करके एक कार्य को 14 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं।

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              प्रयुक्त संकल्पना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              कुल कार्य = कुल दिनों की संख्या × कुल लोग

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              गणना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              कुल कार्य 14 × 7 × 4 इकाई होगा। 

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              इसलिए अभीष्ट दिनों की संख्या,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 14 × 7 × 4 / 12 × 8 = 49/12 = 4\\(\\frac{1}{12}\\) दिन

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

                                                                                                                                                                రోజుకు 4 గంటలు పనిచేసే 7 మంది వ్యక్తులు ఒక పనిని 14 రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలరు.

                                                                                                                                                              మొత్తం పని = మొత్తం రోజుల సంఖ్య × మొత్తం వ్యక్తులు

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              గణన:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              మొత్తం పని 14 × 7 × 4 యూనిట్లుగా ఉంటుంది

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              కాబట్టి అవసరమైన రోజుల సంఖ్య,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 14 × 7 × 4 / 12 × 8 = 49/12 = 4 \\(\\frac{1}{12}\\) రోజులు

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ సరైన ఎంపిక 3

                                                                                                                                                              मोठ्या घनाचे आकारमान,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 15दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              धातूच्या तीन घनांच्या बाजू अनुक्रमे 15 सेमी, 18 सेमी आणि 25 सेमी आहेत.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              उपयोजित संकल्पना:

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              घनाचे आकारमान = बाजू3

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              जर आपण तीन घन वितळवले आणि एक मोठा घन बनवला तर आकारमान समान असेल.

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              x2 + 2 = x

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              So,

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              \\(\\frac{x^2+7x+2}{x^2+13x+2}\\)

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 7x + x / 13x + x

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ⇒ 8x / 14x = 4/7

                                                                                                                                                              \n\n

                                                                                                                                                              ∴ The correct option is 3

                                                                                                                                                              • The word "pessimist" is a noun.

                                                                                                                                                                \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Large number of trees were uprooted by the storm yesterday."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "A large number of trees had been uprooted by the storm yesterday."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Trees was uprooted yesterday in a large number by the storm."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm yesterday."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "4", "solution_html": {"en": "\nThe correct answer is "A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm yesterday."\n\n

                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • The structure of the given sentence is as follows:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                  • Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                  • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • Example:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                  • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)
                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                  • They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)
                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • The subject of the given sentence is 'storm'.​​
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • The object of the given sentence is 'a large number of trees'.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • 'Uprooted' will be changed into 'was uprooted'.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • "A large number of trees" is treated a unit and we must use "was" with it.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • The preposition "by" is used to indicate the doer of the action in the passive voice.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.
                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t​
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                Correct sentence: A large number of trees were uprooted by the storm yesterday.

                                                                                                                                                                \n Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • "Pass on" means to give or transfer something to someone else. (किसी दूसरे को कुछ देना या हस्तांतरित करना)\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                  • Example: Some organizations passed on substantially less money to the candidates.
                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • This phrasal verb is often used in the context of passing on information or a message.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • The verb "pass" can also mean to move past something or someone, but in this case, the phrasal verb "pass on" is the correct choice.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • The correct answer is Option 1.
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • Correct passage:
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                Indian culture treats guests as God and serves them and takes care of them as if they are a part and parcel of the family itself. Even though we don’t have anything to eat, the guests are never left hungry and are always looked after by the members of the family. Elders and respect for elders is a major component in Indian culture. Elders are the driving force for any family and hence the love and respect for elders comes from within and is not artificial. An individual takes blessings from his elders by touching their feet. Elders drill and pass on the Indian culture within us as we grow.

                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • Option 3, "hold on," means to wait or to pause for a moment. (एक पल के लिए रुकना)
                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                • Option 4, "grow on," means to become more appealing over time (usually in reference to a person, thing, or idea).
